correctness.rationale: Every transition of the mechanical word is accounted for in the exact no-consecutive-ones alternation identity. Distinct threshold points split the rotation interval into exactly four nonempty classes. Explicit event-order parity cases identify exactly one Abelian merge. Rank and frequency formulas follow from the n+1 Sturmian factor intervals and uniform distribution. Finite checker replay passed 3,000 cell tests plus 400 direct-prefix tests; the proof covers all n.

value.rationale: Complete natural classification of two recent run-reduced complexity invariants for every Sturmian word and every length, including exact factor-fiber multiplicities, occurrence frequencies and the Abelian pair-merge rule. It directly extends the invariant to a canonical minimally complex aperiodic family without asserting application beyond the proven setting.
